claim_scope: Existence of a 252-word uniform-length binary instance of width 80 with exact optimum 2590 and a legal greedy word of length 5190
integrity: Exact standalone finite checks support the explicit construction; codeword overlap scaling and universal lower bound are proved in RESULT.md
scientific_limitations: Does not determine the minimum failing binary input length
Claims the existence of one legal adverse tie-breaking, not bad performance for every tie-breaking
The 17-letter width-eight witness and alphabet-reduction principle are established prior work
Priority among unindexed explicit short binary constructions is not independently certified
title: An 80-bit binary counterexample to the factor-two greedy superstring bound
